title: The Bosphorus Brief — October 11, 2026
overview: A missile attack on Riyadh's airport dominates regional coverage today, with ripple effects for anyone transiting the Gulf. Closer to home, a new under-15 social media law takes effect November 1, and the lira holds steady as the central bank signals confidence on inflation.
sections: <parameter name="heading">Riyadh Airport Attack: What Travelers Need to Know
body: A missile strike on Riyadh's airport late Saturday killed 12 and injured over 300, according to Saudi aviation authorities, Reuters, and the BBC. Houthi forces had reportedly warned of a strike on the facility days earlier. International outlets (Reuters, NBC, Sky News) frame this as the deadliest attack on Saudi soil in over a decade, with US officials reportedly weighing a response against Houthi positions. If you have layovers or travel plans through Riyadh, check with your airline directly — flight disruptions are likely in the near term. This is a developing story; we'll follow confirmed details only, not speculation about next steps.
